description: The international standard for Notices to Skippers (NtS), maintained for River Information Services by the European Committee for drawing up Standards in the field of Inland Navigation (CESNI) through its working group CESNI/TI/NtS, gives a standardised data format for the notices that national and local fairway authorities must issue to inform waterway users about safety and accessibility. Coverage: the status of inland waterway infrastructure such as bridges and locks, failures of aids to navigation, temporary blockages of waterway sections or other infrastructure, works, water level and depth information, ice information and weather messages, published on the Internet (pull services) or by e-mail (push services). Under Resolution 2019-II-9 the working group prepared a revision to NtS Standard Edition 5.0 with updates to the NtS XSD schema and web service specification, and advises the European RIS platform and the CCNR. Format and access: technical specifications, an XML schema and a web service specification referenced from the CESNI RIS pages. Licence and cost: free to consult; no licence stated. Caveats: the page describes the working programme; the current edition was not confirmed on the page read. The message types can structure waterway closure and lock outage events in inland navigation network flow and emergency response models. It relates to the EuRIS Notices to Skippers dataset and the EuRIS API in the catalogue.
